# EnviroServe Technologies Pvt. Ltd. — Comprehensive Technical & Service Documentation

## Overview
EnviroServe Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (headquartered in New Delhi, India) operates state-of-the-art recycling facilities and specialized regulatory consultancy desks supporting the transition from a linear waste disposal economy to a circular recovery model.

## Operational Taxonomy

### 1. Recycling & Recovery Stream
- **E-Waste Recycling**: Processing IT hardware, server racks, telecommunication switches, printed circuit boards (PCBs), CRTs, display units, and consumer appliances. Operations include manual de-manufacturing, automated shredding, eddy-current non-ferrous metal separation, and certified Form-6 recycling documentation.
- **Li-Ion & Battery Recycling**: Closed-loop processing for EV packs (LFP, NMC, LCO, LMO), renewable storage banks, and consumer lithium cells. Process includes deep-discharge neutralisation, inert crushing, electrolyte recovery, and Black Mass extraction yielding Cobalt, Nickel, Lithium, and Manganese.

### 2. Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Portfolios
- **E-Waste EPR**: Target calculation based on equipment lifespan tables, registration on the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) online portal, and verified recycling credit procurement.
- **Battery Waste EPR**: Target fulfillment under Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022 covering material recovery percentage thresholds for Lead, Lithium, Cobalt, and Nickel.
- **Plastic Waste EPR**: Offsetting plastic packaging footprints across Category I (Rigid Plastics), Category II (Single-layer flexible), Category III (Multi-layered plastics), and Category IV (Compostable plastics).
- **Waste Tyre EPR**: Acquiring verified EPR certificates generated by authorized Crumb Rubber Modifiers (CRM) and Pyrolysis units.
- **Used Oil EPR**: Procuring re-refining recycling certificates for base oil and automotive lubricant importers and manufacturers.
- **Multi-Category Advisory**: Consolidated single-window management desk for conglomerates requiring cross-category compliance filings across multiple CPCB portals.
- **Annual Filing & Audit Support**: Pre-filing ICEGATE Customs import reconciliation, sales ledger auditing, and annual returns execution.

### 3. Enterprise Operational Solutions
- **Circular Economy Responsibility (CER)**: Establishing branded take-back bins in retail and corporate centers, organizing consumer awareness workshops, and formalizing informal scrap aggregators into traceable closed-loop collection streams.
- **Reverse Logistics**: Pan-India fleet operating under Form-9 hazardous waste transit manifests, equipped with shock-proof containers and real-time GPS tracking.
- **Enterprise Asset Liquidation**: Certified data wiping meeting DoD 5220.22-M and NIST 800-88 standards, physical hard drive shredding, and fair-market residual valuation for corporate IT retirements.
